Construct L2-normalized float32 CSR TF–IDF from supplied titles/descriptions; missing metadata yields empty neighbor lists. Use fused sparse multiplication/top-k, e.g. `sp_matmul_topn(X_block, X.T, top_n=65)`, remove self, retain K=64. Avoid materializing the full product, even sparsely: common terms can make it nearly dense. Stored features/neighbors require O(nnz(X)+NK) memory, plus implementation-dependent worker scratch; construction work can approach quadratic with overlapping vocabulary. Prune frequent terms and bound vocabulary/document length. [Implementation](https://github.com/ing-bank/sparse_dot_topn). These are proposed local settings, not measured optima.

For every valid training position, gather its positive item's neighbors plus uniform candidates, initially C=32 total. Vectorize membership checks using sorted user training-history IDs and batched `searchsorted`, checking equality after clamping insertion indices. Exclude padding, positive targets, duplicates and all observed training positives; never consult held-out labels. Avoid B×L×C×history broadcasting. Refill through bounded rounds; for small eligible pools, sample with replacement or reduce candidate count using masks; skip negative loss when no eligible item exists. [Searchsorted](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.searchsorted.html). Seed preprocessing=0 and training/sampling=42, including workers; use deterministic item-ID tie breaking because [topk ties are unstable](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.topk.html).

Score candidates with detached HSTU features/embeddings under `no_grad`; uniformly select among descending-score ranks 4–16, adjusted to the actual eligible count, then recompute selected scores with gradients. This moderate-hardness band is a hypothesis addressing [false-negative risks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.19276). For P valid positions and dimension d, dot-product mining costs O(PCd), with O(PCd) gathered-embedding memory unless chunked; score chunks of 1,024 positions. Backbone cost remains additional; benchmark throughput locally. Metadata guides training sampling only; retain one HSTU checkpoint per category.
